title: World Cup 2026: Pick your England XI for the semi-final against Argentina - BBC Sport
text:
Declan Rice went off at half-time of the quarter-final win over Norway

England are through to the World Cup semi-finals, where they will play Argentina.

The Three Lions beat Norway 2-1 to reach the last four, with Wednesday's match (20:00 BST) to be shown live on the BBC.

Use our selector below to choose your starting XI.
